REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: THE FLAG THAT CERTIFIES THIS REPAIR MISSTATES ITS OWN SCOPE. The committed packet-set manifest marks SEVEN entries requiredBeforeFiling for ma-expunge-k-set. The repair discloses two of them verbatim and excludes five. reports/blanks-left-for-the-participant.json sets everyRequiredBeforeFilingItemIsDisclosed true and explains the exclusion in whatThatFlagCovers as: it does not cover the manifest sign, pay_fee or apply_fee_waiver entries, whose recorded descriptions for this packet set are "Required.", "None identified in the review." and "None identified.". That sentence names three excluded entries. There are five. The two it does not name are complete_field entries whose descriptions are NOT empty: "Petitioner signature — Petition signature block." and "The Specifically narrative — Petition narrative section." They are excluded by PARTICIPANT_ACT_KINDS = ["obtain_document","confirm_answer"] at builder line 1470, silently. A reader of that report concludes every substantive manifest requirement reaches the guide verbatim; two do not. VF41 checked whether the participant is nonetheless told to do both, and they are — step 8 directs signing and dating and step 6 directs the Specifically narrative, from the form-blank list — so there is NO participant-facing gap here. What fails is the attestation: a committed report that certifies its own completeness and gets its own exclusion list wrong is the misleading-signature-block class, and FIX02 own commit message repeats the same undercount. The repair is: correct the sentence to name all five, or bring the two complete_field acts into the disclosed set, and decide which deliberately rather than by a kinds filter nobody reading the report can see.

laneFindings.title: The nine counters are bit-for-bit invariant across this repair, on both granted families.
laneFindings.measured: VF41 ran verify-packet-completeness.mjs --family on both granted families at 59b2133a843ffa629b0eb2f6fbd74e4266d1746f, then checked the pre-repair participant-instructions.md and source-receipt.json out of f63d56734^ into the tree and ran it again. Before and after are identical in every respect: al-felony-nonconviction-90-set PASS_COMPLETE 30/216 written with all nine counters zero, mn_petition_609a02_subd3-set PASS_COMPLETE 21/131 written with all nine counters zero. Not merely both-pass — the same verdict, the same written ratio, the same nine zeros. FIX02 claim is CONFIRMED.
laneFindings.meaning: The nine counters cannot distinguish a guide that names a sworn election from one silent about it, nor a guide that orders a participant to fill a blank that does not apply to them from one that conditions it. REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, as a participant-facing obligation, is invisible to every counter the factory has. The tree was restored to HEAD and verified clean by digest afterwards.

laneFindings.title: The shared anchor-capture reader transposes glyphs within a line, not only mis-decodes ZapfDingbats.
laneFindings.measured: On delivered page 9 of al-felony-nonconviction-90-set canonical.pdf, scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs returns "Page 1 of 3 Rev. 5/2042". pdftotext -layout on the same page and the same bytes returns "Page 1 of 3 Rev. 5/2024". The reader has reordered the digits of the form revision date. Separately, and as FIX02 reported, the same reader returns "4STATE OF ALABAMA" where the page prints a ZapfDingbats check mark before STATE OF ALABAMA: ZapfDingbats code 0x34 is a check mark and the reader emits the raw character 4. Both confirmed.
laneFindings.meaning: All four of FIX02 guards compare a quoted string against this reader output with .includes(). A reader that can reorder glyphs can, in principle, assemble a line that is not visually contiguous on the page and report a quotation as printed when it is not. VF41 independently re-located every quoted line with pdftotext and all thirteen are genuinely printed where the guides say, so no current guard pass is wrong. The mechanism is nonetheless unsound and the transposition is a live defect in a reader four builders depend on.

laneFindings.title: A refused MN build leaves the fabricated text in the participant-facing guide on disk.
laneFindings.measured: scripts/build-census-v1-mn_petition_609a02_subd3-set.mjs writes participant-instructions.md at line ~2132 and asserts the FEE102 guards immediately after. laneFindings.meaning: The refusal is not atomic. A build that stops for a real cause leaves a participant-facing document rewritten past the point the guard rejected. Nothing downstream distinguishes that file from a completed one.

laneFindings.title: What al-felony counters would have said, measured rather than inferred.
laneFindings.measured: VF41 measured al-felony-nonconviction-90-set the way its sibling does, independently: a whole-page pixel differential of all 11 delivered pages against BOTH pinned sources (CR-65 c2e0c7bd..., 8 pages; C-10-CRIMINAL 527d4cfd..., 3 pages; delivered 1-8 and 9-11 respectively), 300 dpi, grey<=200, WITH annotations. Canonical: 57672 px of added ink total, removed ink 0 on nine of eleven pages. Boundary: 89654 px added. On delivered pages 5 and 6 the ONLY added ink is the case-number header and, on page 6, the printed petitioner name — no election box on either page carries a single added pixel, on either fixture. Every word carrying added ink across all 11 pages is a value this build declares it writes, plus the one C-10 caption tick the builder asserts it makes.
laneFindings.therefore: Had al-felony measured refusedFieldsWithInk instead of typing [], it would have measured empty — the literal happens to be true. That does not make it a measurement, and it is worth saying which of the two claims VF41 is making: the packet is clean, AND the counter proving it is unmeasured. The sibling shows what the difference is worth: al-trafficking --negative-control turns its zero into 139 on demand, so its zero is falsifiable. al-felony zero is not falsifiable by anything.
laneFindings.andOneThingNoCounterIsDefinedOver: nonWhitespaceGlyphsOutsideMeasuredWriteBoxes cannot be recomputed for al-felony from its committed artifacts at all, because production-field-map.json publishes NO geometry for its writes — a write row carries only fieldId, fieldName, effectiveLabel, documentId, page and factId, and no rectangle. The counter is defined over measured write boxes the family never records. It is not merely unmeasured; it is unmeasurable from what is committed.
laneFindings.alsoObserved: Delivered pages 9 and 11 show 194 px and 196 px of REMOVED ink against the source, deterministic and identical on both fixtures, in a narrow left-margin column (page 11: x 52-93 pt, y 157-447 pt) where 145 px is also added. That is the signature of small marks shifting sub-pixel between the AcroForm source render and the flattened delivery, not of erased content — but no counter in the nine is defined over removed ink at all, so nothing in the factory would have told anyone either way.
